text:
Predicates:
PlayingFor(x, y) ::: x plays for y.
Brazilian(x) ::: x is Brazilian.
Nautico(y) ::: y is a football club called Nautico.
Braga(y) ::: y is a football club called Braga.
Question: No one playing for Nautico is Brazilian.

Premises:
Ailton(x) ∧ BornIn(x, 1995) ∧ KnownAs(x, Ailton) ::: Ailton Silva was born in 1995 and is known as Ailton.
PlayingFor(x, Braga) ::: Ailton was loaned out to Braga.
PlayingFor(x, Nautico) ::: Ailton Silva plays for Nautico.
Brazilian(x) ::: Ailton Silva is Brazilian.
Nautico(y) ∧ Braga(y) ::: Nautico and Braga are football clubs.

Conclusion:
¬∃x (PlayingFor(x, Nautico) ∧ Brazilian(x)) ::: No one playing for Nautico is Brazilian.
